components.gap: The composite suite is incomplete: the nonstandard-model subcomponent is present, but the Skolem-paradox explanation (GOAL-02) and the inclusion/embedding part of upward Lowenheim-Skolem via elementary diagrams (GOAL-03) are partial, as stated under those components.

The explanation of the Skolem-paradox internal/external countability distinction is incomplete: it must state that the model satisfies the existence of an uncountable set because the set theory proves that existence (e.g. Cantor's theorem for the power set of omega), rather than only saying the model 'can satisfy' it; and it must explain why the internally uncountable set is externally countable, namely that its external extension {b in dom M : M satisfies b in a} is a subset of the countable domain, while no enumeration of it is an element of the model.
